additional_info.subject: RE: ID0459294-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / NN 170000063] Charging issue CRM:03056000395
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Kunwar,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0459294.
The ticket was opened for several charging sessions registered as 0kWh on charger
MP/NN 170000063.
I had a look at the timestamps you provided, and:
The sessions are considered as 0kWh because the charger sends via Backend the same meterStop value as the meterStart.
This is caused by an issue on ERK chargers in regards of the OCMF data information. This is possible to see it in the logs as it is reported that the OCMF record is invalid.
I verified all the session you reported, and I can confirm that all the sessions were reporting 0kWh due to this issue:
The good news is, this issue has already been addressed by our R&D, and it will be fixed in the next FW release. The FW
v8.1.X
will be released in CW47 (2 weeks from now).
I would therefore recommend to update the charger to
v8.1.X
as soon as it will be released. You can reach out to our colleagues from RC-DE to have support to update your charger.
Since the fix will be included in the next FW, and a release date is already planned, I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you and wish you a nice weekend.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
